lines.text: Nobody fails MECEE-BL on the questions they don't know.
They fail on the ones they guessed.
Thirty-eight guesses. Nine and a half marks gone. About a thousand ranks.
So stop guessing. Every wrong answer comes back worked out.
Two hundred questions. Three hours. Marked like the real paper.
Then it shows you where you actually stand.
Two full mocks, free. Sit one tonight.

bgm.query: tense minimal underscore with a hard driving pulse and a low teal-cold synth bass, sparse percussive ticks like a clock, resolving bright and confident in the last third; instrumental, no vocals, modern trailer-pop for a short vertical ad
